buildingToday._readme: Actual photographs from the construction site, oldest first. Add each photo's date (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD) once known.
buildingToday.summary: Construction has started. The site has been set out, the trenches dug, the footings cast and the foundation walls built.

photos.caption: Setting out: engineers and the Jamia's team go over the plans on the cleared site.
photos.alt: Engineers in yellow hard hats and members of the Jamia studying drawings on open, cleared ground inside the boundary wall, with marker poles standing in the soil.

photos.caption: Excavation: an excavator digs the foundation trenches.
photos.alt: A long, deep foundation trench cut into sandy soil, with an excavator and piles of earth beyond it beside the boundary wall.

photos.caption: Foundation: workers fix timber formwork around the steel for a column footing.
photos.alt: Two workers in a foundation pit fixing wooden shuttering around a cage of steel reinforcement bars for a concrete column.

photos.caption: Foundation: the concrete foundation walls are in place, with steel bars standing ready for the columns.
photos.alt: Low concrete foundation walls marking out the rooms of a building on the sandy site at sunset, with steel reinforcement bars rising at the corners and the boundary wall behind.

paragraphs: Jamia Masjid Syeda Amina R.A. is named after Sayyidah Aminah, the blessed mother of the Prophet ﷺ. The Jamia that is building it, Jamia Islamia Abdullah Bin Abdul Muttalib R.A., is named after his blessed father.

The Jamia brings together a masjid, a madrasa and a khanqah as one system of education and spiritual training, modelled on Masjid an-Nabawi. Its aim is to prepare people who become an example of the straight path in knowledge, practice, conduct and character.
A large number of students study at the Jamia. Every student receives accommodation and meals free of charge, paid for by donations including Zakat and Sadaqat.
story.missionUr: مسجد نبوی ﷺ کی طرز پر مسجد، مدرسہ اور خانقاہ کے جامع نظام تعلیم و تربیت کے ذریعے ایسی شخصیات کی تیاری ہمارا مقصد ہے جو علم، عمل، اخلاق اور کردار میں صراطِ مستقیم کی پہچان بنیں۔

_sources.poster_madrasa_2026-11-09: Urdu madrasa appeal poster (Jamia's Urdu name, mission, Muhtamim, accounts).
_sources.poster_construction_2026-11-09: English construction poster for Jamia Masjid Syeda Amina R.A. (name, emblem, stage, materials costs, phones, accounts, address). The poster is undated.
_sources.notes: English renderings of Urdu text are translations the Jamia should confirm. Project country and city come from the construction poster address.
_sources.jamia_introduction_pdf: 'Jamiah Abdullah ibn Abdul Muttalib' introduction (Word PDF): naming, patron, foundation-stone date and guests, departments.
_sources.masjid_plans_pdf: 'MASJID' architectural sheet by Arch Vision Plus: basement, ground and first-floor plans and area schedule. Floor totals add to 50,584 sq ft; the sheet states 50,583 sq ft, which is shown.
_sources.student_poster: Jamia student appeal poster: courses, free board and meals, about Rs 100,000 per student per year, Zakat and Sadaqat. Student photos on that poster are NOT used (minors; consent not confirmed).
_sources.nameVariants: Materials spell the names differently: 'Jamia Islamia Abdullah Bin Abdul Muttalib R.A' (construction poster), 'Jamia Islamia Sayyed Abdullah Bin Abdul Muttalib (RA)' (student poster), 'Jamiah Islamiyah Abdullah bin Abdul Muttalib' (introduction PDF); masjid: 'Jamia Masjid Syeda Amina R.A.' (poster) vs 'Jame' Masjid Sayyidina Aminah' (PDF). The site uses the construction poster's spelling.
_sources.layout_plan_pdf: 'LAYOUT_PLAN' master plan by Arch Vision Plus; PDF created 15 December 2021.
